SPEI.

Source: R/SPEI-package.r
SPEI.Rd

A set of functions for computing potential evapotranspiration and several widely used drought indices including the Standardized Precipitation-Evapotranspiration Index (SPEI).

Details

Functions spei and spi are the workhorse of the SPEI library. Other functions, such as kern and parglo.maxlik, are auxiliary low-level functions that will not be used directly by the typical user. Functions for computing potential evapotranspiration are provided, too, for helping computing the SPEI. They are: thornthwaite, hargreaves and penman.

References

S.M. Vicente-Serrano, S. Beguería, J.I. López-Moreno. 2010. A Multi-scalar drought index sensitive to global warming: The Standardized Precipitation Evapotranspiration Index – SPEI. Journal of Climate 23: 1696, DOI: 10.1175/2009JCLI2909.1.

https://spei.csic.es
